item.title: arm64e pointer authentication: PAC keys, PACIASP, A12
item.description: On arm64e the hardware signs the pointers worth hijacking and checks them on use. The key is out of reach of any memory write, so attacks work around it. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Google Adopts DPoP to Strengthen OAuth 2.0 Against Token Theft and Replay Attacks
item.description: Google's OAuth Platform has recently introduces support for Demonstrating Proof-of-Possession (DPoP), an OAuth 2.0 security mechanism designed to mitigate token theft and replay attacks. By Sergio De Simone (1 source: infoq)
